figurative_meaning_en: Something easily obtainable or readily available
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই সুযোগটা গাছের ফল, যে চাইলেই পেয়ে যাবে।
বাজারে এই ফলগুলো গাছের ফলের মতো সস্তা এবং সহজলভ্য।
example_sentences_in_english: This opportunity is like fruit from a tree; anyone who wants it can get it easily.
These items in the market are as easy to get as fruit from a tree.
note: The idiom draws from natural imagery common in agrarian Bengali society.
